text:
sam_cs: hey team — Auriga day0 smoke hit a few infra blockers. quick list: (A) outbound egress to our log endpoints blocked by customer FW, (B) KMS key policy missing our service role, (C) S3 bucket policy needs tightening to prevent accidental public puts, (D) low week0 usage flagged by finance as an early renewal risk. assigning owners below.
taylor_net: can you paste the curl/trace? which destination is failing?
sam_cs: trace shows TLS handshake failing to logs.redwood.prod:443, error: `connection timed out` from bastion -> nat. customer says they only allow egress to vendor IP ranges.
taylor_net: our log IPs are 35.199.40.0/24 and 35.199.41.0/24. i'll draft a minimal CIDR allowlist and justification they can hand to compliance. snippet: `egress allow tcp 35.199.40.0/24:443, 35.199.41.0/24:443 // Redwood audit endpoints, TLS only`

jin_kms: note on KMS: their key policy restricts to `aws:PrincipalOrgID` and blocks cross-account roles. we need `arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/redwood-logs` added with Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. i'll post a minimal policy line in the ticket.
olivia_sre: short-term workaround if they refuse egress: deploy a Splunk HF inside their VPC and have our agent push to that via internal IP. requires cross-account assume-role and SSM document to bootstrap. Ops overhead but avoids changing FW.
sam_cs: good option. customer prefers minimal footprint though — asking for justification first. i'll send the allowlist + justification: `centralized telemetry to Redwood for security monitoring; only to fixed IP ranges; TLS 443; no inbound from our side.`
mike_finance: renewal signal: week0 ingestion is ~6% of projected. i'd like a 14-day activation plan to show ramp. can CS propose?
sam_cs: propose plan: day0 smoke + unblock, day1 full ingest QA, days 2-7 seed traffic with internal test users, days 8-14 scale to production with feature flags. will log schedule in CS-9274 and share with MM.
taylor_net: one more technical ask — customer NAT gateway is assigned ephemeral IPs. they asked for FQDN allowlist instead of CIDR. we only publish IP ranges today. advising them that FQDN allowlists can lead to resolution issues; prefer fixed egress ranges. we'll push a support note.
jin_kms: also — their S3 bucket `auriga-logs-prod` has a wide put policy. recommend `Condition: StringEquals: aws:PrincipalArn = arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/redwood-logs` + deny public. i'll attach sample policy in the ticket.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-9274 assigned to cs/infra/sec. SLA 72h. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-9274
sam_cs: next steps: (1) i'll send allowlist + justification to Auriga compliance this afternoon, (2) taylor will prepare proxy playbook in case FW change is delayed, (3) jin to circulate KMS + S3 policy snippets to their cloud sec, (4) i'll publish the 14-day activation plan to CS-9274 and sync with PM. update by EOD. :thumbsup:
